text.en: Settlers carried two Christian civilizations here from Europe, one English-speaking and one French-speaking. Canadian society today grows mostly out of those two.
text.fr: Des colons ont apporté d'Europe deux civilisations chrétiennes, l'une anglophone et l'autre francophone. La société canadienne d'aujourd'hui en découle en grande partie.

source.quote: Canadian society today stems largely from the English-speaking and French-speaking Christian civilizations that were brought here from Europe by settlers.

verification.evidence: Canadian society today stems largely from the English-speaking and French-speaking Christian civilizations that were brought here from Europe by settlers.

text.en: For most people here, the two languages of everyday life are English and French.
text.fr: Pour la plupart des gens, les deux langues de la vie de tous les jours sont l'anglais et le français.

source.quote: English and French define the reality of day-to-day life for most people

verification.evidence: English and French define the reality of day-to-day life for most people and are the country’s official languages.

text.en: Most Francophones in Canada live in Quebec.
text.fr: La plupart des francophones du Canada vivent au Québec.

source.quote: While the majority of Francophones live in the province of Quebec

verification.evidence: While the majority of Francophones live in the province of Quebec, one million Francophones live in Ontario, New Brunswick and Manitoba, with a smaller presence in other provinces.

text.en: The people of Quebec are called Quebecers, and most of them speak French.
text.fr: Les habitants du Québec s'appellent les Québécois, et la plupart d'entre eux parlent français.

source.quote: Quebecers are the people of Quebec, the vast majority French-speaking.

verification.evidence: Quebecers are the people of Quebec, the vast majority French-speaking.

text.en: Quebecers keep an identity, a culture and a language of their own.
text.fr: Les Québécois conservent une identité, une culture et une langue qui leur sont propres.

source.quote: maintain a unique identity, culture and language.

verification.evidence: Quebecers are the people of Quebec, the vast majority French-speaking. Most are descendants of 8,500 French settlers from the 1600s and 1700s and maintain a unique identity, culture and language.
